provenance.purpose: New fixed 20-run cohort after removing the pre-lease XML inspection and unused cache hashing; explicit ConfigLock unlock. Original T90 gates and complete unchanged editor probe. Prior failed 40-run frozen-runtime cohort remains reported separately.
provenance.runtime_source: Unchanged exact JS from candidate-inflight-protocol.vsix; all 38 out and 2 resource JS match checkout

comparison.resource_note: RSS/PSS includes all tracked launch descendants. Idle excludes its first second and precedes the additional 30 steady hovers. PSS once per ten samples, RSS every 100 ms. OS page cache is not flushed.

source_integrity.algorithm: Sort relative POSIX path strings; SHA256(UTF8(path) + NUL + binary SHA256(file)) for each file, then SHA256 of the concatenation.

limitations: Only Linux/VSCodium was checked. Windows, macOS, VS Code and Remote remain unverified.
Prior failed cohorts are retained. Absolute times vary substantially across cohorts for both baseline and candidate; no causal explanation for the host-wide timing change was confirmed.
This acceptance uses the unchanged fixed paired gates; it does not claim an absolute upstream-handler speedup or a permanent latency bound.
Cold removes only owned project caches; OS page cache is not flushed. Baseline always precedes candidate.
Support policy is disabled for both timing variants and enabled in dedicated native guard/protected acceptance.
